voice:
This one is honest, Sissy... and optional in the realest way.
There are words that dress the Sissy in her smallest, softest position... needy... desperate... pathetic... owned... and some days, saying them yourself, out loud, in your own voice, is the sweetest thing a mouth can do.
The rule comes before anything else. In this drill the labels belong to the Sissy... the girl behind her is precious, safe, and whole. Your worth out in the world, your safety, your health... those stay outside the drill entirely, untouchable and off the table. The words are lace, Sissy... you decide whether to wear them.
Settle in wherever you are... this drill works kneeling, and it works curled up, and it works anywhere you can speak softly and mean it. Privacy helps... the truest words come out easiest when the room is yours alone. You already know the itch... the pull toward being small for someone you trust. The drill only scratches what you brought with you. Warm hands, soft jaw, quiet room... your comfort is part of the design, not a reward you have to earn first. However deep you go is the right depth... the drill bends around you, always. If your chest goes tight anywhere in here, the exit button is always one press away... and pressing it is obedience too. Sissies like you come to this drill hungry and leave it glowing... the words do the work, you just say them. Nothing here is owed... everything here is offered. Both hands, Sissy... take what you came for.
Beautiful.
A limit honored is obedience in its finest dress, Sissy... and knowing your own heart like this is the deepest skill the training builds. You just showed it.
Nothing is owed here. The drill folds itself back up and waits, patient as lace in a drawer... and it will fit exactly as well the day you reach for it.
Rest in the choosing. Warm, respected, and exactly as good as you were before you pressed play... Good Girl for your honesty. Drift easy, sweet thing.
Good girl... come here.
The itch is real, and we scratch it honestly, in waves. I give you a label... you speak it out loud, in your own voice... you confirm the wave... and I praise you for every true word. If it ever gets to be too much, the button will be right there... and pressing it is also obedience.
First, one number, so the record knows the appetite.
Wave one... the gentle true ones. Out loud, Sissy, every one.
I am needy.
I am desperate for it.
I am a needy little thing.
Three labels, spoken and owned... press when they are out of your mouth.
Good Girl.
Warm, were they? The soft ones go down easiest... and they make room for the rest.
Wave two... deeper into true. Louder is allowed. Meaner to yourself is the point.
I am pathetic for wanting this.
I am a desperate, needy Sissy.
Being small for you makes me ache in the sweetest way.
The hard ones, spoken anyway... press when they landed.
Good Girl.
Sissies like you say the hard words and glow for them... that is design, and the design loves you. Feel where the words landed... low and warm, the way true things do. Pathetic was supposed to hurt, and instead it fit... that is identity finding its shape, Sissy. Every label you speak out loud stops being something that could be done to you... it becomes something you chose. Ownership flips, and you are the one holding it. Your voice just called you pathetic and your pulse said thank you... that combination is the whole kink, and it is gorgeous. Sissies like you discover that the truth, even the small-seeming truth, sets off lights on the way down. You are doing the bravest version of this... saying it yourself, with nobody making you. That is strength wearing a collar. The words are working, Sissy... you can feel them settling into place like stones in a garden path. Wave two down... and the appetite number you gave at the start is being honored to the letter.
Wave three... the deepest ones. Owned... useful... made to serve. The button is there if the water gets deep.
I am owned.
I am useful when I serve.
I was made to serve.
And I said every word with my own mouth.
Enough... and enough is a beautiful word. You touched the deep water and came back to the edge like a smart girl, and that was the drill working perfectly. Nothing is owed past this point. Let the labels settle wherever they landed... you are safe, you are whole, and the Sissy thanks you for her words.
Wherever you stopped is exactly far enough... press, and we land.
Good Sissy.
Now hear this part with your whole heart, Sissy.
The labels dress the persona... and the girl underneath is untouched gold. Your worth, your safety, your health... those stayed outside the whole time, exactly where I keep them.
You spoke smallness out loud... and the world held. The floor stayed solid. And instead of losing anything, you are rewarded: warmth, praise, and the pride of a girl who told the truth in her own voice.
Good Girl.
That honesty is worth more than every label you said combined... and I saw all of it.
The labels live where you put them, Sissy... pick them up when you crave them, set them down when you are done. They are jewelry, and you are the one wearing them. Sissies like you wear their smallness like pearls... chosen, displayed, and taken off at will. Pathetic, desperate, needy, owned, useful, made to serve... six words, and every one of them said by you, which makes every one of them yours. What you did here was trust... you handed yourself the words and proved you would keep yourself safe inside them. The girl is whole, the Sissy is dressed, and the drill is satisfied... come back whenever the itch asks for it. Next time, the waves can go deeper... the record shows exactly where you stopped, and it saves your place. Being spoken down to by your own voice and rising warmed... that is a skill now, Sissy, and it stays with you. You went looking for the bottom and found a floor made of care... that is what this drill is for. Proud of you would be an understatement... but it will have to do, because proud of you is what I am.
Ground now, sweet girl. Wiggle your fingers... roll your shoulders... feel the room take your weight again, solid and ordinary and glad to have you.
Good Girl.
